lessonTitle: 39. The tangent plane to a sphere
lessonTitleEnglish: The tangent plane to a sphere
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A plane with exactly one common point with a sphere is a tangent plane; it is perpendicular to the radius drawn to that point.
stages.headlineEnglish: A plane with exactly one common point with a sphere is a tangent plane; it is perpendicular to the radius drawn to that point.

stages.headline: A plane touches a sphere exactly when the distance from the centre to the plane equals R.
stages.headlineEnglish: A plane touches a sphere exactly when the distance from the centre to the plane equals R.

stages.headline: Example: R = 5 and A is 13 from the centre; the tangent segment from A is √(169 − 25) = 12.
